anchored_through.description: The range's events are anchored through this event; later ones are anchored within the hour.

anchors.description: The hourly signed anchors in the range, each checked against the recomputed chain.

close_anchors.description: The signed close snapshots in the range, each checked against the stored snapshot and the chain (AUD-04).

details.description: The security events' request details checked against the fingerprints in their bodies (AUD-06).

details_checked.description: false when this service holds no fingerprint key, so the details were not checked.

events.description: How many events the range holds: each recomputed and linked to the one before it.

failed_seq.description: failed: the first event that does not agree, when the failure has one.

first_seq.description: The first event of the range, by its place in the chain; 0 when no event occurred in it.

from.description: The range's first day, in the organisation's time zone.

last_seq.description: The last event of the range.

outcome.description: passed: every link, anchor and detail agrees. failed: the trail was altered; problem and failed_seq say where. explained: a purge boundary or a restore left a gap, each with its signed record (AUD-09).

problem.description: failed: what does not agree, in words.
examples: event 201 was altered: its body no longer gives its stored hash
